articles.title: This Morgan Stanley Analyst Turns Bullish; Here Are Top 4 Upgrades For Monday
articles.teaser: Wall Street analysts made changes to their ratings on Zscaler, Dell Technologies, Federal Realty, and CNO Financial. See their views on these stocks.
articles.body:
Top Wall Street analysts changed their outlook on these top names. For a complete view of all analyst rating changes, including upgrades, downgrades and initiations, please see our analyst ratings page.

  • Guggenheim analyst John DiFucci upgraded Zscaler Inc (NASDAQ:ZS) from Neutral to Buy. Zscaler shares closed at $139.73 on Monday. See how other analysts view this stock.
  • Morgan Stanley analyst Erik Woodring upgraded Dell Technologies Inc (NYSE:DELL) from Underweight to Equal-Weight and raised the price target from $170 to $448. Dell shares closed at $420.91 on Monday. See how other analysts view this stock.
  • Mizuho analyst Vikram Malhotra upgraded Federal Realty Investment Trust (NYSE:FRT) from Neutral to Outperform and raised the price target from $121 to $130. Federal Realty shares closed at $119.63 on Monday. See how other analysts view this stock.
  • Evercore ISI Group analyst Thomas Gallagher upgraded CNO Financial Group Inc (NYSE:CNO) from Underperform to In-Line and raised the price target from $43 to $48. CNO Financial shares closed at $46.22 on Monday. See how other analysts view this stock.

articles.title: Zscaler, AutoZone, And Regencell Are Among Top 10 Large-Cap Losers Last Week (May 25-May 29): Are The Others In Your Portfolio?
articles.teaser: Weak guidance, analyst target cuts and declining energy prices weighed on Zscaler, AutoZone, PDD Holdings and other large-cap stocks, making them last week's biggest losers.
articles.body:
These ten large-cap stocks were the worst performers last week. Are they a part of your portfolio?

Zscaler, Inc. (NASDAQ:ZS) fell 20.06% last week after the company reported third-quarter financial results and issued fourth-quarter sales guidance with its midpoint below estimates.

Cerebras Systems Inc. (NASDAQ:CBRS) declined 16.83% last week.

Boston Scientific Corporation (NYSE:BSX) slumped 16.95% last week after multiple analysts lowered their price forecast on the stock.

AutoZone, Inc. (NYSE:AZO) decreased 14.21% last week. The company reported third-quarter financial results. Multiple analysts lowered their price forecast on the stock.

Fervo Energy Company (NASDAQ:FRVO) fell 13.09% last week.

PDD Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:PDD) decreased 9.14% last week. Multiple analysts lowered their price forecast on the stock.

Regencell Bioscience Holdings Limited (NASDAQ:RGC) decreased 12.61% last week.

Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) slumped 0.87% last week.

Imperial Oil Limited (AMEX:IMO) declined 11.53% last week.

Venture Global, Inc. (NYSE:VG) decreased 10.87% last week. Shares of oil and gas-related companies traded lower as energy prices pull back after President Donald Trump said he is meeting in the White House Situation Room to make a final determination on a potential agreement with Iran.
